title: Accelerate
prompt: A car at speed gains acceleration pixels per second every second. Return its speed after one frame.
signature: func solve(speed: float, acceleration: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(speed: float, acceleration: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return speed
hint: Same shape as moving a position, but for speed.
solution:
func solve(speed: float, acceleration: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return speed + acceleration * delta
